description: Sites AI cites in answers that name a competitor but not the member's brand (Kliqo's Gap analysis), largest gaps first, with the prompts behind them. Pass domain to see the answers for one site. Use for "where are competitors winning?" or "which sites should mention us?". Needs sign-in to Kliqo (read-only).

domain.description: One site or URL from the list, to see its answers

end_date.description: Exact end date (YYYY-MM-DD), today at the latest

model.description: Only this AI model's answers; leave out for the project's current models

project.description: Project name, domain or id; leave out for the workspace's current project

range.description: Date range, ending today in the project's time zone

start_date.description: Exact start date (YYYY-MM-DD), for example the 1st of a month; use with end_date instead of range

name: get_competitor_gaps
title: Get my competitor gaps
